component.name: Paint
component.summary: Draw and paint images in a clean GNOME workspace

description.p: Paint is a fast, distraction-free raster drawing and painting application built with GTK 4, Libadwaita, and Cairo in the style of GNOME Text Editor and Ptyxis.

ul.li: Multi-layer editing with OpenRaster (.ora) projects, opacity, blend modes, alpha lock, layer lock, and drag-and-drop layer reordering
Selection tools (Rectangle, Ellipse, Freehand Lasso, Magic Wand) with 8 resize handles and Invert Selection
Smooth anti-aliased brush, line, 9 shapes, eraser, tolerance-aware Flood Fill with Sample All Layers, Linear/Radial Gradient, Blur/Pixelate retouch, and rich multiline Text
Live-preview Brightness/Contrast, Hue/Saturation, and Gaussian Blur adjustments plus Sharpen, Invert Colors, Grayscale, and Trim Transparent
Full transparency support with checkerboard backdrop and transparent brush and fill tools
Stylus tablet pressure sensitivity, dual Primary/Secondary swatches, Custom Palette, and customizable keyboard shortcuts
Tabbed canvases with tab overview, cursor coordinate HUD, edge resize handles, Spacebar panning, printing, and atomic session restore
Open and export OpenRaster (.ora), PNG, JPEG, WebP, and BMP images

description.p: OpenRaster layers, advanced tools, live filters, stylus input, and canvas UX upgrades:

ul.li: Native OpenRaster (.ora) project support, Export Image dialog (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP), and printing
Layer Alpha Lock, Layer Lock, drag-and-drop reordering, Solo Layer, Copy Merged, Paste as New Layer, and Import Image as Layer
Ellipse, Freehand Lasso, and Magic Wand selections, Invert Selection, and 8 interactive resize handles
Tolerance-aware Flood Fill with Sample All Layers, Linear/Radial Gradient (Transparent, Alpha Lock, and selection clipping), and Blur/Pixelate retouch brushes
Stylus pressure sensitivity and hardware eraser routing, dual Primary/Secondary swatches, Custom Palette, and direct on-canvas multiline Text editing
Live-preview Brightness & Contrast, Hue & Saturation, and Gaussian Blur filters plus Sharpen, Invert Colors, Grayscale, and Trim Transparent
Top-left coordinates HUD, Spacebar panning, right-click context menu, live edge resize preview, and memory-budgeted atomic autosave

description.p: Layers, customizable shortcuts, selection and text tools, and startup sizing controls:

ul.li: Multi-layer editing with opacity, six blend modes, collapsible Layers sidebar, Merge Down, Flatten Layers, and per-layer undo
Selection tool with move, nudge, clipboard Cut/Copy/Paste, Paste as New Canvas, and Crop to Selection
Text tool with live preview, font family, size, Bold, and Italic styling
Eyedropper tool with cursor color preview swatch, Alt hold picking, and Recent Colors history
Brush styles (Smooth, Soft, Pixel), Block Arrow shape, Spacebar shape repositioning, Resize and Scale dialog, Rotate/Flip, Fit to Window, and Pixel Grid
Customizable keyboard shortcuts and startup window/canvas sizing options in Preferences

description.p: New drawing tools and full transparency support:

ul.li: Full alpha transparency support when opening, editing, resizing, and saving PNG and WebP images, with a checkerboard backdrop
New Transparency tool (Brush, Fill, and Clear to Transparent) for making parts of a drawing transparent
New Shapes tool with 8 shapes, outline and filled modes, and Shift proportion snapping
New Line tool with live preview and 45-degree Shift angle snapping
Quick Clear Canvas button in the floating toolbar
Fast, seam-free drawing and zooming on large canvases up to 3200%
Two-finger touchscreen pinch-to-zoom and pan support
Cursor-anchored zooming and smoother low-zoom step transitions

description.p: Initial release with tabbed canvases, brush, eraser, flood fill, session restore, and Adwaita preferences.
